text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: A few days after Admire Vega collapsed in the forest.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She underwent a thorough examination just to be safe, but with no abnormalities found in her left leg or anywhere else, she was discharged. However...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her faint reply made my heart ache.
To put it bluntly, her condition was—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Not a single word from her, and none that I could utter.
Dragging the heavy silence behind us, we leave the hospital.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —And sure enough...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Bwahahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Anytime, anywhere, in any situation,
just as relentlessly loud as ever—
the Overlord's booming laughter echoed out.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations on being discharged, Ayabe-san.
Now then, please take this.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —I brought the 'invitation'.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: An invita... tion...?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, if you're going to gaze, include that Trainer over there too, please!
After all—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: "Fuji-senpai told me with a smile so intensely pressuring it would scare Hel herself, 'I simply cannot permit this without a guardian!' Bwahahaha!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Wondering what this was all about and feeling confused,
before I knew it—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before I knew it, T.M. Opera O had dragged me out to the beach at night... or rather, in the dead of night.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And there...

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha...
Sorry to spring this on you out of nowhere, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: A-Actually, we also suddenly received an invitation from Opera O-san...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Um, well, I don't really know
what kind of stuff might be there, but...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But knowing Opera O-san,
something super important must be happening right here...!!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Nessun dorma... None shall sleep... *mumble*.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Hawawa!? Even Opera O-san, who loves keeping a regular schedule, is fast asleep, yes she is...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh, what is your problem?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I don't have time for this. I'm going ho—

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You must not go back.
...Stay here, Ayabe-san.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Until the deepest, darkest hour of night has passed.
Until the starlight twinkles, and slowly fades away.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: You're right here, with all of us.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed like she was about to say something,
but in the end, she simply fell silent
and quietly sat down on the sandy beach.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The ebbing and flowing surf, the soft breathing of TM Opera O who seemed to have fallen asleep early, and the occasional murmurs of Meisho Doto and the others echoed quietly.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In some ways it felt like a long time, but in others, it felt like it went by in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The stars that once filled the night sky
began to vanish, one by one—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Slowly, very slowly, the sky began to turn white with dawn.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Can you see it? —It's the dawn.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: This is the dawn—for you, and for all of us.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: ...Mnya.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Dawn, when the stars have faded. ...It's blinding.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
(Even so...
she's still just... far too dazzling for me—)

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Mmmgh... Haah!
My body went totally stiff.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: So, Ayabe-san! Opera O-chan doesn't look like she's waking up anytime soon, and Doto-chan fell asleep too—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: "If you feel up for a run, come jogging with me! Just for a little bit!!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Huh? H-Hold on...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rather unusually for Narita Top Road,
she dashed off without even waiting for a reply.
A moment later, Admire Vega started running too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the early morning, where even the gentle lap of the waves sounds subdued,
the crisp footsteps of two runners along the shore
echo vibrantly—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Haah, haah, haah...
Ayabe-san, what's gotten into you?!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It's like that sharp burst of speed from before was a lie!
...I know you're capable of running so much better than this.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ...I suppose... it can't be helped.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What is it?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: You're too far away—I can't hear you!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ……Ngh, …………aaaaargh!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: It can't be helped, okay?!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I just wanted to make amends to my sister who died in my place!
I kept running just to dedicate my victories to her, and yet...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"She's gone now, she's nowhere to be found!
She's not even watching over me from the stars!"

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Because it vanished!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Once again... they disappeared to save me,
all for my sake...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, it's not like you'd understand
what this means anyway.
So just leave me alone!!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I'm completely empty! I've got nothing left...!!

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
...Yes.
Losing my reason to run, feeling completely empty—

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Now that it's down to zero...
How are you feeling yourself right now?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Ngh, ... Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
It was completely meaningless, totally empty,
brought to some beach without a clue, staying up all night,
and then forced to run like crazy on top of that.

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: What do you yourself think right now, Ayabe-san?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
"...Even so, running together
really is fun after all, you know?"

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Is it just conceit on my part
to feel like we share the same feelings?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text:
Still not quite getting it?
Then shall we run some more?

text_block_list.name: Narita Top Road
text_block_list.text: Together, until the sky grows brighter!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And then, Admire Vega ran again.
She ran, and ran, and ran, and ran—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Before long, both Narita Top Road and I were utterly exhausted, falling asleep as if all our strength had been drained.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...By the time I got all four of them into a taxi
and arrived back at the academy,
it was already well into the afternoon.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After squinting and staring steadily
up into the dazzling sunlight, she—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...It was... so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
I actually thought it was fun.
Both running... and competing.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
Even though I've lost all meaning, all purpose...
Even so, I—

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: I... still want to keep running...!

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: B-But...—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Watching her unable to take the leap, I think to myself:
—What an incredibly kind older sister she is.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "She rightly fears it. Because she knows that the final thread tethering the departed to this world is the hearts of those who remember them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "If I forget about my little sister and start running solely for myself—then someday..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She fears that one day she will irrevocably forget her sister,
and that her sister's existence will vanish entirely."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If that's the case, then—
choice_data_list: Let's run so your sister can be proud of you.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"I tell them they must be proud.
Having magnificently run through the Classic Triple Crown,
the Grand Prix races, and countless Senior races—"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: If only I had an older sister like that.
choice_data_list: You'll definitely be able to boast about it, right?
It's definitely something to be proud of, right?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ......Heh... What's that even supposed to mean?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (Pride... Bragging, huh.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: (My pride and joy—my big sister.)

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: ...Do you think they'll praise me?

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text:
"If I run a lot and win a lot...
...then maybe someday, I'll be able to see her."

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: When that time comes... please take care of me.

text_block_list.name: Admire Vega
text_block_list.text: Will you... praise me—?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod firmly, over and over. In that instant,
tears that had welled up in the corners of my eyes
spilled over rapidly, and I had to hurriedly wipe them away.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeing me like that,
Admire Vega let out a faint, amused smile.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: She was smiling in the midday light.
